senses.en: to read a text carefully to find and correct errors

example.en: She proofread the report before sending it to the manager.
example.zh: 她在把报告发给经理之前先校对了一遍。

senses.en: strict control and organization of people's behavior

example.en: Employees resented the regimentation of their daily schedule.
example.zh: 员工们对日常作息受到严格管制感到不满。

senses.en: the open area in front of a large building; in Britain, also the paved area of a petrol station

example.en: Fans waited in the forecourt of the theatre.
example.zh: 影迷们在剧院前院等候。

senses.en: the amount that a train can carry; a very large quantity

example.en: Trainloads of coal arrive at the port every week.
example.zh: 每周都有整列车的煤运抵港口。

senses.en: in Buddhism, a person regarded as having achieved enlightenment; especially the historical teacher Siddhartha Gautama, written Buddha
senses.zh: 佛；佛陀（佛教中觉悟者的称号，尤指释迦牟尼）

example.en: The book describes the life and teachings of the Buddha.
example.zh: 这本书介绍了佛陀的生平与教导。

senses.en: involving or amounting to treason

example.en: He was accused of treasonable acts against the state.
example.zh: 他被指控犯有叛国行为。

senses.en: an internet site where users can talk to each other in real time

example.en: The old chatroom was full of fans discussing the show.
example.zh: 那个旧聊天室里挤满了讨论这档节目的粉丝。

senses.en: (British) thick strips of fried potato; (American) thin crispy potato slices
senses.zh: 炸薯条（英式）；炸薯片（美式）

example.en: We had fish and chips for dinner.
example.zh: 我们晚餐吃了炸鱼薯条。

senses.en: small disks used to represent money in gambling

example.en: He put all his chips on red.
example.zh: 他把所有筹码都押在红色上。

senses.en: small pieces broken off from wood, stone, or other material

example.en: Wood chips covered the ground under the trees.
example.zh: 树下地面铺满了木屑。

senses.en: people who are in the same class at school as you

example.en: My classmates and I studied together for the exam.
example.zh: 我和同学们一起复习备考。

senses.en: easy to notice; obvious

example.en: There was a marked improvement in his grades.
example.zh: 他的成绩有明显提高。

senses.en: not wearing any clothes; naked

example.en: Nude bathing is allowed at that beach.
example.zh: 那个海滩允许裸泳。

senses.en: a work of art showing an unclothed human body

example.en: The gallery displays several famous nudes.
example.zh: 该美术馆展出几幅著名的裸体画。

senses.en: a very small two-piece swimsuit worn by women
senses.zh: 比基尼泳装；三点式泳装

example.en: She bought a new bikini for the beach holiday.
example.zh: 她为海滩度假买了一件新的比基尼泳装。

senses.en: without delay; at once

example.en: Please call me immediately if you need help.
example.zh: 如果你需要帮助，请立刻给我打电话。

senses.en: directly next to or close to something

example.en: There is a pharmacy immediately next to the station.
example.zh: 车站紧邻着一家药店。

senses.en: completely different from something else

example.en: The two teams have opposite views on the plan.
example.zh: 两队对该计划持相反的观点。

senses.en: facing or across from someone or something

example.en: She sat at the opposite end of the table.
example.zh: 她坐在桌子对面的一端。

senses.en: a person or thing that is as different as possible from another
senses.zh: 对立的人或事物；相反者

example.en: Love is often described as the opposite of hate.
example.zh: 爱常被描述为恨的对立面。

senses.en: on the other side of something, facing it

example.en: They live opposite the post office.
example.zh: 他们住在邮局对面。

senses.en: to fill something with air or gas

example.en: He used a pump to inflate the air mattress.
example.zh: 他用气泵给充气床垫充气。

senses.en: to make prices, numbers, or the importance of something higher than they should be

example.en: Some sellers inflate their prices before the holidays.
example.zh: 有些卖家在节假日前抬高价格。

senses.en: a poor, crowded area of a city with bad living conditions

example.en: Millions of people in the city live in slums without clean water.
example.zh: 这座城市里有数百万人住在没有干净水源的贫民窟里。

senses.en: to spend time in poorer places or with poorer people, often just out of curiosity (disapproving)
senses.zh: （出于好奇）到贫民区体验生活

example.en: Tourists who go slumming may offend local residents.
example.zh: 去贫民区猎奇游览的游客可能会冒犯当地居民。

senses.en: to praise someone insincerely to gain favor

example.en: He flattered his boss hoping for a promotion.
example.zh: 他奉承老板，希望能升职。

senses.en: to make someone feel pleased or honored

example.en: She was flattered that they invited her to speak.
example.zh: 他们邀请她发言，她感到很荣幸。

senses.en: the land by the sea, especially used as a place for holidays

example.en: We spent our summer holiday at the seaside.
example.zh: 我们在海边度过了暑假。

senses.en: happy and cheerful

example.en: He is a jolly old man who always smiles.
example.zh: 他是个总是面带微笑的快活老人。

senses.en: (British, informal) pleasant or enjoyable

example.en: We had a jolly time at the beach.
example.zh: 我们在海滩玩得很开心。

senses.en: (British, informal) very; extremely

example.en: It was a jolly cold day.
example.zh: 那天冷得很。

senses.en: (informal) to cheer someone up or tease them jokingly

example.en: The kids jollied each other along during the trip.
example.zh: 旅途中孩子们互相逗乐。

senses.en: an organic compound made only of carbon and hydrogen atoms

example.en: Oil and natural gas are mixtures of many different hydrocarbons.
example.zh: 石油和天然气是多种不同碳氢化合物的混合物。

senses.en: continuing forever or for a very long time

example.en: They promised each other everlasting love.
example.zh: 他们彼此许下永恒的爱。

senses.en: a plant with flowers that keep their shape and color when dried
senses.zh: 蜡菊类植物（干后不变形变色）

example.en: She dried some everlastings for the winter bouquet.
example.zh: 她晒了一些蜡菊做冬季花束。

senses.en: an experienced person who guides and advises someone less experienced

example.en: She was my mentor during my first year at the company.
example.zh: 她是我入职第一年的导师。

senses.en: to guide and advise someone as a mentor

example.en: Senior engineers often mentor new employees.
example.zh: 资深工程师常常指导新员工。

senses.en: loving someone very much and loyal to them

example.en: He is a devoted father to his children.
example.zh: 他是一位深爱孩子们的父亲。

senses.en: used only for a particular purpose

example.en: The magazine is devoted to travel.
example.zh: 这本杂志专门刊载旅游内容。

senses.en: recently; just done or made

example.en: The room smelled of freshly baked bread.
example.zh: 房间里弥漫着刚烤好的面包的香味。

senses.en: having received a good amount of schooling or knowledge

example.en: Most people in the town are highly educated.
example.zh: 镇上的大多数人受过良好教育。

senses.en: based on knowledge or experience rather than pure chance
senses.zh: 有依据的；基于知识或经验的

example.en: This is an educated guess, not a confirmed result.
example.zh: 这是有依据的推测，而不是已经证实的结果。

senses.en: thinking about something too much and unable to stop

example.en: He is obsessed with old movies and watches one every night.
example.zh: 他痴迷于老电影，每晚都看一部。

senses.en: a separate section of a container, bag, or vehicle

example.en: She kept her passport in a side compartment of the suitcase.
example.zh: 她把护照放在行李箱侧面的隔层里。

senses.en: a separate seating area in a train

example.en: They shared a sleeper compartment on the night train.
example.zh: 他们在夜行列车上共用一个卧铺隔间。

senses.en: known by many people; famous

example.en: She is a well-known writer in Japan.
example.zh: 她是在日本很有名的作家。

senses.en: a group of people who work together for a common purpose, such as a company or club

example.en: She works for an international organisation that helps refugees.
example.zh: 她在一家帮助难民的国际组织工作。

senses.en: the way parts are arranged or the act of arranging things in an orderly way

example.en: The success of the event was due to her careful organisation.
example.zh: 这次活动的成功归功于她周密的组织安排。

senses.en: in a way that is large or important enough to be noticed

example.en: Sales increased significantly after the new policy was introduced.
example.zh: 新政策出台后，销售额显著增长。

senses.en: in a statistically meaningful way

example.en: The two groups differed significantly in test scores.
example.zh: 两组的测试成绩差异具有统计学显著性。

senses.en: in a way that expresses a special meaning

example.en: She looked at him significantly and said nothing.
example.zh: 她意味深长地看了他一眼，什么也没说。

senses.en: a common male given name

example.en: Andrew is my older brother's name.
example.zh: 安德鲁是我哥哥的名字。

senses.en: possibly; in a way that may happen or be true

example.en: The new drug could potentially save many lives.
example.zh: 这种新药有可能挽救许多生命。

senses.en: a famous person, especially in entertainment or sports

example.en: The actor became a celebrity after the movie was released.
example.zh: 这部电影上映后，那位演员成了名人。

senses.en: the state of being famous and admired

example.en: She struggled with the pressures of celebrity.
example.zh: 她苦于成名带来的压力。

senses.en: a soft fabric with uncut loops, usually cotton, used for towels and bathrobes

example.en: This bathrobe is made of soft terry.
example.zh: 这件浴袍是用柔软的毛巾布做的。

senses.en: the activity of operating and controlling a vehicle

example.en: Driving in heavy rain requires extra care.
example.zh: 在暴雨中开车需要格外小心。

senses.en: strong and forceful in pushing something forward

example.en: Snow and a driving wind made travel difficult.
example.zh: 大雪和劲风使出行变得困难。

senses.en: showing great energy and determination
senses.zh: 精力充沛的；进取心强的

example.en: She is a driving and ambitious manager.
example.zh: 她是一位干劲十足、雄心勃勃的经理。

senses.en: an official order or authority to do something

example.en: The president claimed a mandate from voters to reform the tax system.
example.zh: 总统声称获得了选民授权来改革税收制度。

collocations: have a mandate to do something

senses.en: an official instruction that must be obeyed

example.en: The agency issued a mandate requiring safety inspections.
example.zh: 该机构发布了要求进行安全检查的指令。

senses.en: to make something required by law or rule

example.en: The new law mandates that all workers receive safety training.
example.zh: 新法律规定所有工人必须接受安全培训。

senses.en: a state of noise, confusion and disorder

example.en: The announcement caused a tumult in the crowd.
example.zh: 这一通告在人群中引起骚动。

senses.en: disagreeing with an official or majority view

example.en: The dissenting judge explained why she disagreed with the ruling.
example.zh: 持异议的法官解释了她为何不同意该裁决。

senses.en: a small island, used especially in poetry or place names
senses.zh: 小岛（常用于诗歌或地名）

example.en: They sailed to a remote isle.
example.zh: 他们乘船前往一座偏远的小岛。

senses.en: between two categories or of uncertain acceptability
senses.zh: 两可之间的；介于……之间的

example.en: The test result was borderline, so the doctor ordered a second one.
example.zh: 检查结果处于临界，所以医生要求再做一次。

senses.en: a dividing line or boundary

example.en: The referee's decision was right on the borderline.
example.zh: 裁判的判罚正好在界限边缘。

senses.en: a small open booth or stand, often selling tickets, newspapers or snacks

example.en: I bought a newspaper at the kiosk.
example.zh: 我在报亭买了份报纸。

senses.en: a small self-service machine providing information or services

example.en: You can check in using the self-service kiosk.
example.zh: 你可以在自助服务终端办理登机手续。

senses.en: the most important part of something, giving it strength or support

example.en: Fishing is the mainstay of the island's economy.
example.zh: 渔业是这座岛屿经济的支柱。

senses.en: a very thin crisp cookie or biscuit

example.en: She bought a chocolate wafer from the shop.
example.zh: 她在商店买了一块巧克力威化饼。

senses.en: a thin slice of semiconductor material used to make microchips

example.en: The factory produces silicon wafers for computer chips.
example.zh: 这家工厂生产用于计算机芯片的硅晶圆。

senses.en: a thin flat disk sealed as a guarantee or used in religion

example.en: The package was closed with an official wafer.
example.zh: 包裹用一枚官方封签封好了。

senses.en: different from the one already mentioned

example.en: She lives on the other side of the street.
example.zh: 她住在街道的另一边。

senses.en: additional or further

example.en: Are there any other questions?
example.zh: 还有别的问题吗？

senses.en: other people or things

example.en: Some students left; others stayed.
example.zh: 一些学生离开了，其他人留下了。

senses.en: a large purple vegetable with firm white flesh
senses.zh: 一种紫色、果肉白色的大型蔬菜；茄子

example.en: She roasted eggplant with garlic and olive oil.
example.zh: 她用大蒜和橄榄油烤茄子。

senses.en: the plant that produces eggplants

example.en: We grow eggplant in the garden every summer.
example.zh: 我们每年夏天在花园里种茄子。

senses.en: to let something fall

example.en: She dropped the keys on the table.
example.zh: 她把钥匙掉在桌子上了。

senses.en: to become lower in amount or level

example.en: Sales dropped sharply last month.
example.zh: 上个月销售额急剧下降。

senses.en: a small round amount of liquid

example.en: A drop of rain fell on the window.
example.zh: 一滴雨落在窗户上。

senses.en: a fall or decrease in amount or level

example.en: There was a sudden drop in temperature.
example.zh: 气温突然下降。

senses.en: a place designated for crossing something, such as a road, railway, river, or national border
senses.zh: 过街处；铁路道口；渡口；口岸

example.en: The children waited at the pedestrian crossing.
example.zh: 孩子们在人行横道处等候。

senses.en: an act or journey of going across something, especially water

example.en: We booked a ferry crossing to the island.
example.zh: 我们预订了去岛上的渡轮航程。

senses.en: a point where two lines, paths, or ideas meet or intersect

example.en: The crossing of the two paths is marked on the map.
example.zh: 两条小路的交叉点在地图上标了出来。

senses.en: a deep round dish used for food or liquid

example.en: She put the fruit in a large bowl.
example.zh: 她把水果放进一个大碗里。

senses.en: the amount of food in a bowl

example.en: He ate a bowl of noodles for lunch.
example.zh: 他午饭吃了一碗面。

senses.en: to throw or roll a ball in cricket or bowling

example.en: He bowled a fast ball in the match.
example.zh: 他在比赛中投出一个快球。

senses.en: an official document signed by a court or judge allowing the police to do something, such as make an arrest or search a place

example.en: The police obtained a warrant to search the building.
example.zh: 警方获得了搜查这栋建筑的搜查令。

senses.en: to be enough reason for something; to justify
senses.zh: 使有必要；为……提供正当理由

example.en: Such a serious error warrants an official apology.
example.zh: 如此严重的错误有必要作出正式道歉。

senses.en: a good reason for doing something

example.en: There is no warrant for such an accusation.
example.zh: 这种指控毫无根据。

senses.en: a military operation in which an army surrounds a place and cuts off supplies to force it to surrender

example.en: The enemy army laid siege to the city for three months.
example.zh: 敌军围攻这座城市长达三个月。

senses.en: a long period of being attacked or pressured, e.g. by illness or problems

example.en: He suffered a long siege of health problems last year.
example.zh: 他去年长期受健康问题的困扰。

senses.en: a political and economic system in which property is owned by the community and there is no private ownership

example.en: The textbook explains the basic ideas behind communism.
example.zh: 这本教科书解释了共产主义的基本思想。

senses.en: extra work done beyond one's regular working hours

example.en: She earns extra money from overtime.
example.zh: 她通过加班赚取额外收入。

senses.en: extra playing time added to a game to break a tie

example.en: The game went into overtime.
example.zh: 比赛进入了加时赛。

senses.en: for longer than the usual working hours

example.en: The staff often work overtime during busy periods.
example.zh: 繁忙时期员工经常加班。

senses.en: to bring goods or services into a country from abroad

example.en: The country imports most of its oil from overseas.
example.zh: 该国大部分石油依赖进口。

senses.en: goods or services brought into a country from abroad

example.en: Coffee is one of the main imports of this country.
example.zh: 咖啡是这个国家的主要进口商品之一。

senses.en: to transfer data or files into a program or document from another source

example.en: You can import your contacts from another email account.
example.zh: 你可以从另一个电子邮箱账户导入联系人。

senses.en: a narrow road or path, especially between houses or fields

example.en: She walked down a quiet lane to the village shop.
example.zh: 她沿着一条安静的小巷走到村里的商店。

senses.en: a marked division of a road for a line of traffic

example.en: Please stay in the right lane when driving slowly.
example.zh: 慢速行驶时请待在右侧车道。

senses.en: a marked path for swimmers or runners in a race

example.en: She won the race from lane four.
example.zh: 她在第四赛道赢得了比赛。

senses.en: to make something straight, or to become straight

example.en: She straightened the picture frame on the wall.
example.zh: 她把墙上的相框扶正了。

senses.en: to make a situation clearer or more organized

example.en: It took weeks to straighten out the accounting records.
example.zh: 理清账目花了好几个星期。

senses.en: an area of land covered with trees; a small forest

example.en: They took a walk through the woods behind the village.
example.zh: 他们在村子后面的树林里散步。

senses.en: love for and loyalty to one's country

example.en: His patriotism inspired him to serve his country.
example.zh: 他的爱国精神激励他为国效力。

senses.en: the gradual gathering or increase of something

example.en: An accumulation of snow blocked the road.
example.zh: 积雪堆积，堵住了道路。

senses.en: a complicated network of paths or tunnels in which it is easy to get lost

example.en: Visitors wandered through the labyrinth of narrow streets.
example.zh: 游客们在狭窄街道构成的迷宫中漫步穿行。

senses.en: the intricate structure of the inner ear involved in hearing and balance

example.en: An infection in the inner labyrinth can affect balance.
example.zh: 内耳迷路的感染会影响平衡。

senses.en: fond of arguing or quick to disagree

example.en: He gets argumentative when he's tired.
example.zh: 他累的时候变得爱争辩。

senses.en: to make a mistake; to be wrong

example.en: To err is human; everyone makes mistakes sometimes.
example.zh: 人皆犯错；人人都会出错。

collocations: err on the side of caution

senses.en: a tall cereal plant with large yellow ears; corn (British usage)

example.en: Farmers grow maize in the fields behind the village.
example.zh: 农民们在村子后面的田地里种植玉米。

senses.en: a pale yellow color

example.en: The wall was painted in a shade of maize.
example.zh: 墙被漆成了淡黄色。

senses.en: a final demand that must be met, or serious consequences will follow

example.en: He gave his roommate an ultimatum: pay the rent or move out.
example.zh: 他给室友下了最后通牒：要么交房租，要么搬走。

senses.en: belief or acceptance that something is true

example.en: New evidence lent credence to his story.
example.zh: 新的证据使他的说法更可信。

senses.en: having a pleasant taste

example.en: The soup was simple but quite palatable.
example.zh: 这道汤简单却十分可口。

senses.en: acceptable or easy to accept

example.en: The manager offered a more palatable compromise.
example.zh: 经理提出了一个更易接受的折中方案。

senses.en: weapons and military equipment

example.en: The country spent billions on new armaments.
example.zh: 该国在新的武器装备上花费了数十亿。

senses.en: (especially British, less common form of overseas) across the sea; foreign

example.en: The company relies on oversea markets for much of its revenue.
example.zh: 这家公司很大一部分收入依赖海外市场。

senses.en: across or beyond the sea

example.en: Many students travel oversea to study.
example.zh: 许多学生出国留学。

senses.en: a light splashing sound of water

example.en: We could hear the gentle plash of water against the boat.
example.zh: 我们能听到水轻拍船身的潺潺声。

senses.en: to splash water lightly

example.en: Fish plashed at the surface of the pond.
example.zh: 鱼在池塘水面上扑腾起水花。

senses.en: to arrange or put something together again in a new way

example.en: The photographer recomposed the shot to include the mountains.
example.zh: 摄影师重新构图，把群山纳入画面。

senses.en: to calm oneself or become calm again

example.en: She paused to recompose herself before answering.
example.zh: 她停顿了一下，让自己平静下来再回答。

senses.en: pieces of furniture with a flat top and legs

example.en: The restaurant has ten tables for customers.
example.zh: 这家餐厅有十张供顾客使用的桌子。

senses.en: sets of numbers or facts arranged in rows and columns

example.en: The report includes several tables of statistics.
example.zh: 这份报告包含几个统计表格。
